channel.title: somewhereus.com
channel.description: USA travel guides for road trips, national parks and weekend getaways: routes, permits, seasons, where to stay and what it costs.

item.title: Utah's Mighty 5 national parks: the road-trip plan
item.description: A 7 to 10 day route through Zion, Bryce Canyon, Capitol Reef, Arches and Canyonlands, with permits, drive times and seasons.

item.title: Grand Teton National Park: barns, lakes and the jagged peaks
item.description: What to see in Grand Teton National Park, from Mormon Row and Oxbow Bend to Jenny Lake, plus how to combine it with Yellowstone and Jackson.

item.title: Park City, Utah: an old silver town with Olympic snow
item.description: What to do in Park City in winter and summer, from skiing and Historic Main Street to the Utah Olympic Park, plus getting there from Salt Lake City.

item.title: Moab, Utah: a base camp for arches, canyons and the Colorado River
item.description: What to do in Moab, from Arches and Canyonlands to Dead Horse Point, Scenic Byway 128 and Corona Arch, plus when to go and how to plan from Salt Lake City.

item.title: Yellowstone: how to plan a first trip to the first national park
item.description: How many days to spend in Yellowstone, the best geysers and wildlife spots, which entrance to use, when roads are open and how to plan from Salt Lake City.

item.title: Monument Valley: the Valley Drive, the movie views and how to visit
item.description: How to visit Monument Valley Navajo Tribal Park, drive the Valley Drive, find Forrest Gump Point and John Ford's Point, and plan a trip from Salt Lake City.

item.title: Route 66 road trip: how to drive the Mother Road at 100
item.description: How long to drive Route 66, the best stops from Chicago to Santa Monica, which stretches to choose if you are short on time, and tips for the centennial.

item.title: Bonneville Salt Flats and the Great Salt Lake: a day trip from Salt Lake City
item.description: How to visit the Bonneville Salt Flats, Antelope Island, the Spiral Jetty and Golden Spike, with timing, road tips and the history of the speed racers.

item.title: The Pacific Coast Highway road trip, San Francisco to LA
item.description: How to drive California's coast on Highway 1, with the best stops, how many days to allow and Big Sur closure tips.

item.title: How to plan a national park trip without the stress
item.description: Reservations, park passes, lodging and timing: a checklist for planning a US national park trip.

item.title: A winter road trip through Arizona
item.description: Phoenix, Sedona, the Grand Canyon's South Rim and Tucson: a sunny 7-day winter route through Arizona.

item.title: A weekend in Salt Lake City, summer or winter
item.description: What to do in Salt Lake City in a weekend, from downtown and the Great Salt Lake to ski canyons and Park City.
